{{Otheruses|Cane}}
'''Hissing cane''' was a thick-walled reed found in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. When the warm swamp air blew between the reeds and filled the holes in the walls of the reed, they seemed to hiss like the [[Snake/Legends|serpents]] that filled the bogs of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
